title: Cube net opposite face
observableEvidence: Folds a cube net mentally and identifies the face opposite the center square.
prompt: A cube net has square P in the center, Q directly above P, R directly below P, S directly left of P, T directly right of P, and U attached directly above Q. When the net is folded into a cube, which face is opposite P?

contestFormat.eligibility: Grade 8 or below and age 15.5 years or younger on the official contest date.

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.rationale: Q shares an edge with P in the net, so it folds adjacent to P rather than opposite it.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.rationale: R shares an edge with P and folds adjacent to P, even though it is opposite Q.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.rationale: S shares an edge with P and becomes a side face adjacent to P.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.rationale: T shares an edge with P and becomes a side face adjacent to P.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.rationale: Correct: Q folds up beside P, and the square beyond Q folds over to the face opposite P.

solutionRepresentation: The four squares Q, R, S, and T are attached directly to P, so they fold to faces adjacent to P. The square U is attached beyond Q, so after Q folds up, U folds over to the face opposite P.
solutionMethod: Track which net squares share an edge with the center and then fold the square attached beyond an adjacent face across from the center.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept the face name U, the phrase Face U, or choice E.

hintSteps.prompt: Start by identifying the faces that share an edge with the center square in the net.
hintSteps.question: Which faces must become adjacent to the center face?

hintSteps.prompt: The face attached beyond an adjacent face folds after that adjacent face moves upward.
hintSteps.question: Where does the square beyond the top neighbor land relative to the center?

hintSteps.prompt: In a strip of three squares A-B-C, if B is attached to the center face A, then C can fold across from A.
hintSteps.question: Which answer choice plays that beyond-the-neighbor role here?
